title: Josiah’s Reforms

questions.question: What did Josiah do with the Book of the Covenant?
options: He read it in the hearing of the people and made a covenant
questions.correctAnswer: He read it in the hearing of the people and made a covenant
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:2-3 (ESV): "...And he read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant... And the king stood... and made a covenant..."

questions.question: What feast did Josiah keep that had not been kept like this since the days of the judges?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:22 (ESV): "For no such Passover had been kept since the days of the judges..."

questions.question: What did Josiah do to the altar at Bethel?
options: He broke it down and burned the Asherah
questions.correctAnswer: He broke it down and burned the Asherah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:15 (ESV): "Moreover, the altar at Bethel... he pulled down..."

questions.question: How did Josiah die?
options: Pharaoh Neco killed him at Megiddo
questions.correctAnswer: Pharaoh Neco killed him at Megiddo
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:29 (ESV): "Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt went up... King Josiah went to meet him, and Pharaoh Neco killed him at Megiddo..."

questions.question: Who reigned after Josiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:30 (ESV): "...And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah... and made him king..."

questions.question: What did Josiah do to the idolatrous priests?
options: He deposed them and slew priests of the high places on the altars
questions.correctAnswer: He deposed them and slew priests of the high places on the altars
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:5, 20 (ESV): "And he deposed the priests... And he sacrificed all the priests of the high places who were there on the altars..."

questions.question: What specific prophecy was fulfilled when Josiah burnt bones on the altar at Bethel?
options: The word of the LORD that the man of God proclaimed (1 Kings 13)
questions.correctAnswer: The word of the LORD that the man of God proclaimed (1 Kings 13)
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:16 (ESV): "...according to the word of the LORD that the man of God proclaimed..."

questions.question: What happened to Jehoahaz?
options: Pharaoh Neco put him in bonds and he died in Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Pharaoh Neco put him in bonds and he died in Egypt
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:33-34 (ESV): "And Pharaoh Neco put him in bonds... and he came to Egypt, and he died there."

questions.question: Who did Pharaoh Neco make king in place of Josiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:34 (ESV): "And Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim the son of Josiah king... and changed his name to Jehoiakim."

questions.question: How did Jehoiakim obtain the money to pay Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:35 (ESV): "...but he taxed the land to give the money according to the command of Pharaoh."

questions.question: Where did Josiah remove the horses dedicated to the sun?
options: From the entrance to the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: From the entrance to the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:11 (ESV): "And he removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance to the house of the LORD..."

questions.question: Whose monument did Josiah spare?
options: The monument of the man of God who came from Judah
questions.correctAnswer: The monument of the man of God who came from Judah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:17 (ESV): "...It is the monument of the man of God who came from Judah... And he said, 'Let him alone; let no one move his bones.'"

questions.question: What Kings of Judah had built the altars on the roof of the upper chamber of Ahaz?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:12 (ESV): "And the altars on the roof of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made..."

questions.question: Did the Lord turn from his great wrath against Judah after Josiah's reforms?
options: No, because of the provocations of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: No, because of the provocations of Manasseh
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:26 (ESV): "Still the LORD did not turn from the burning of his great wrath... because of all the provocations with which Manasseh had provoked him."

questions.question: How long did Jehoahaz reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 23:31 (ESV): "...and he reigned three months in Jerusalem."

key_verse_text: Before him there was no king like him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his might, according to all the Law of Moses, nor did any like him arise after him. (ESV)
